C0310.title: Wan'an Public Security Cracks a DDoS Hacking Case
C0310.summary: In December 2022, the Cyber Surveillance Unit of the Wan'an County Public Security Bureau found from a superior lead that a resident surnamed Song had launched DDoS attacks against a website, endangering network security. Police located and summoned Song after analysis. The investigation found that Song had obtained DDoS attack scripts while building websites for others, used a virtual machine to build an attack program that paralyzed the target website, and was given administrative detention and a fine.
